edges.description: Atlas is the high-level orientation surface for deciding which owning Velantrim domain or source to open next.
The Master Atlas exposes the Notion Knowledge Tree as a deeper source/evidence/research navigation layer.
The Notion tree points to the Google Drive companion when detailed human-readable commentary and preservation guidance are needed.
This repository machine-encodes the same navigation purpose while the Drive document preserves a more human-readable long-form map.
Knowledge Tree provides local source expansion from one node; Atlas provides higher-level orientation. They complement rather than replace one another.
Knowledge Tree records source/evidence/research adjacency, while Crosswalk records cross-project architectural relations and ownership boundaries.
